scripts.prepare-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const files=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>!['node_modules','android','www','.git','.github'].includes(f)); fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www'); for(const f of files){fs.cpSync(f,path.join('www',f),{recursive:true});}"
